ModMetaData.name: Fieldwork Companions - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Fieldwork Companions, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Twelve features: loading and the four Harmony hooks, the settings page (captured, tagged @review), settings persistence through the game's own file, the hidden MainButtons shortcut, RIMMSQOL revealing and hiding it (pass avec-rimmsqol, with a restart chain), the language the pass runs, the real assists through the vanilla methods the patches hang on, the chance in a live game, and a save that holds nothing of the mod. They need the companion steps assembly built from Tests/Pickle/Source against Mod/Assemblies/FieldworkCompanions.dll. See TESTING.md at the repository root for what each pass covers and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is deliberately left out.
